_meta.purpose: External evidence for the Ashtakoot Yoni koota table (YONI_SCORE / YoniScore) and for the Pathu Porutham Yoni test. Every value here comes from a published table, a competitor's published output or a classical rule; none comes from this library.
_meta.cell_orientation: Every table below is written boy row by girl column in animal_order, transposed from its source where the source uses another layout.
_meta.root_rule: Muhurta Chintamani (vivaha prakarana 25-26) fixes only the seven mahavaira (0) pairs: horse-buffalo, elephant-lion, sheep-monkey, snake-mongoose, dog-deer, cat-rat, cow-tiger. Every other cell comes from a commentator's chakra, and the printed chakras disagree with each other.
_meta.adoption: The library adopts the table the Frawley / Jagannatha Hora / saravali engines share (lineage of the Mahidhar Sharma chakra below), taken cell for cell from PyJHora, except the two cells in `adopted_overrides`, where the printed Mahidhar Sharma chakra gives the same value in both directions and the cross-lineage majority agrees. That table is the only one of the five printed lineages the audit research found that agrees with every competitor spot value in `spot_values`.
_meta.reference_almanac: The reference almanac publishes no Yoni table; its matcher is a form. The cells in `unconfirmed_cells` still want a hand check against it: the first four tell the adopted lineage from the other printed chakras, the last four are where the adopted lineage's own witnesses disagree.

pyjhora._source: PyJHora (Python port of Jagannatha Hora), src/jhora/horoscope/match/compatibility.py, YoniArray, https://github.com/naturalstupid/PyJHora (raw file fetched 2026-09-24). Printed as YoniArray[girl][boy]; the table is symmetric, so no transpose changes it.

mahidhar_sharma_chakra._source: Yonigunah chakra in Mahidhar Sharma's Hindi tika on Muhurta Chintamani (Khemraj / Venkateshwar line), archive.org item muhurta-chintamani-of-daivagya-ramacharya-mahidhar-sharma_202210, page image n97 (printed p. 86). Transcribed from the scan by the 2026-09-24 audit research, rows bride in print, transposed here to rows boy. It carries misprints (for example lion-rat 0 and lion-cow 0, where only the seven mahavaira pairs may be 0), so it is used only for the two overridden cells.

adopted_overrides._source: Mahidhar Sharma chakra: 3 in both directions. PyJHora sets 1; Frawley and saravali give 3 one way and 1 the other; Kedar Datt Joshi, freehoroscopesonline, Gaur Brahman Samaj and Maitreya's code give 3.
Mahidhar Sharma chakra: 2 in both directions. PyJHora and Frawley give 1; Kedar Datt Joshi and Maitreya's code give 2.

pathu_yoni_enemy_pairs._source: The Tamil Yoni porutham is a pass/fail test that fails only on enemy (pagai) animals, not a 0 to 4 score: prokerala yoni-porutham.htm and thirumanaporuthamonline.com yoni-porutham (both fetched 2026-09-24) say so, and PyJHora's South Indian mode returns a boolean from an enemy list and never reads YoniArray. The seven pairs are the Muhurta Chintamani mahavaira pairs, listed verbatim by thirumanaporuthamonline.
pathu_yoni_enemy_pairs.not_adopted: Snake-rat: PyJHora's yoni_enemies_south adds it ('In South India yoni - Snake/Rat are enemies'), as do some Tamil sites, but thirumanaporuthamonline says snake and rat are not enemies. The narrower classical list is used.
